// Runtime fakes for f-watch-and-load.types.ts.
export function regionLabel(region) { return `Region ${region.toUpperCase()}`; }
export const calls = [];
export function fetchHolidays(region, { signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    calls.push({
      region, signal,
      resolve: () => { resolve(Object.freeze([`${region}-holiday`])); },
      reject: (cause) => { reject(cause); },
    });
    signal.addEventListener("abort", () => { reject(new DOMException("aborted", "AbortError")); }, { once: true });
  });
}
